summary.text: Kristin Noble is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 2 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Noble's career experience includes working in security software, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Kristin Noble was born in Manchester, New Hampshire, and lives in Bedford.
Ballotpedia lists her as winning the Hillsborough 2 general elections in 2022 and 2024.
Her 2023-2024 committee assignment was the House Education Committee.
